summary: The respondents, promoted to Superintendent of Central Excise and Customs, challenged the anomaly where junior employees received higher pay due to upgradation under the Assured Career Progression (ACP) Scheme. The High Court directed pay stepping-up under FR 22 to remove the anomaly. The Supreme Court upheld the High Court's decision, holding that the ACP-induced pay disparity required correction under FR 22, even if the senior employees had already been promoted. The appeal by the Union of India was dismissed.
